What a shop. In an over saturated market there are few places that stand out the way these boy’s shop does.

It’s not just the quality of their products and flowers but also the service. We first visited Stoner - Old Town in June of 2025 and we loved the vibe. Upstairs of an awesome little bar. Ascend the stairway to heaven to find a little smokers oasis amongst the cool quirky old quarter. Anyways fast forward to Jan 2026 and we roll into the shop only to be greeted by huge smiles and a: “hey bro I remember you from last time”

What a joy. Cannot wait to come back.

Our visit was really chill and I really recommend this place to anyone if you visit the old town!
